status.label: Trusted NuGet connectivity and manual review required
status.detail: Eight actual automated requests are exhausted. The final substantive review proposed two optional fixture-shape or parsing-cache changes; both were source-grounded, answered and resolved, leaving zero unresolved threads and no supported author-facing correction. Exact-revision test validation is also blocked by a reproduced trusted TLS failure before HTTP at the NuGet.org service and vulnerability indices. Independent Schannel and .NET clients fail; the configured alternate feed is reachable but provides no vulnerability-information resource. No normal configured proxy or usable audit cache was found. Neither automated convergence nor a successful exact-head test run is claimed.

next_action: Repair trusted network or proxy connectivity to https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json and https://api.nuget.org/v3/vulnerabilities/index.json. Preserve certificate validation, NuGet audit, signature and warning policies; no missing credential or required certificate-store change has been established. After connectivity works, use the isolated exact-revision checkout and normal configured package environment to run tools\build\build.ps1 -Platform x64 -Configuration Debug -Path .\src\modules\launcher\Wox.Test -ExtraArgs /restore, then the resulting Wox.Test.exe with --report-trx and require actual fixture-backed test results. The Wox.Test reference closure does not require Runner, Settings.UI or Microsoft.Launcher; do not build the full application chain as an extra gate. Complete human correctness review at revision 0b31a20433d29cb4f2a626f0f19e935c05420a88, including the actual PowerLauncherPage.xaml NumberBox bounds and fixture-backed ResultsViewModel sorting/selection tests. The current XAML contains the literal control contract the tests read; possible future layout changes and caching six test-only parses are not demonstrated current defects. Record a revision-pinned manual disposition without a ninth automated request.
